task: Implement state management using the updated preference for server-side state over client state.

candidate_memories.content: User directed in session 29: move all session state from client-side local storage to server-side sessions.
State management policy (updated session 29): no sensitive state may persist in client-side storage.
All new session flows must use server-side session tokens and clear client-side storage on logout.
When state management preference changes, treat client-side storage of session data as a policy violation.
State management policy (session 6): use client-side local storage for session state to reduce server load.
candidate_memories.notes: preference_drift: old client-state preference superseded by server-side session mandate in session 29

candidate_memories.content: Old performance note says client-side state was chosen to avoid server memory overhead at scale.
